Stranded in the unforgiving wilderness of the remote Canadian Rockies, two estranged teenagers from warring households must rely on each other to survive the brutal elements. As freezing temperatures and apex predators close in, they must also confront the long-buried family secrets and deep-seated betrayals that tore their parents apart. In this breathtaking fight for survival, their greatest obstacle isn't the wild, but the fragile trust they are desperately trying to build.
